title: Apni aghosh mein
body:
haye ya hussain haye ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
chal rahi hai meri gardan pe churi
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
<<DIVIDER>>
keh rahe the ye hussain ibne ali
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
<<DIVIDER>>
tashna lab naazon ka paala hai tumhara beta
qatl ab hone hi waala hai tumhara beta
rukne waali hai har ek saans meri
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
chal rahi hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne bachpan ka nibhata hoo ye waada dekho
maine badla to nahi apna iraada dekho
sar mera kaatne waala hai shaqi
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
chal rahi hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
thak gaya laashein utha kar bhare lashkar ki
laash qasim ki mai laaya hoon kabhi akbar ki
khud banayi hai lehad maine ali asghar ki
do tasalli mujhe seene se laga lo amma
haye ya hussain haye ya hussain
chal rahi hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitni bechain hai amma meri zainab khwahar
aake teele pe wo khud dekh rahi hai manzar
ho rahi hai usay takleef badi
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
chal rahi hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
mar gaya mera jari bhai magar sabr kiya
mere akbar ne sina khaayi magar sabr kiya
mil gayi khaak mein tasveer e nabi
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
chal rahi hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
haajira aasia maryam bhi isi dasht mein hai
nooh bhi hazrate aadam bhi isi dasht mein hai
ro rahe hai meri ghurbat pe sabhi
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
chal rahi hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
kho diye dasht mein aankhon ke ujaale maine
khaliye dil pe bahot dard ke bhaale maine
maut aati hai to aa jaaye abhi
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
chal rahi hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
kalmago khoon rulaate hai mujhe maqtal mein
dekhlo kitna sataate hai mujhe maqtal mein
hil gayi dekhlo maqtal ki zameen
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
chal rahi hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek guzarish hai meri tum se ab itni maadar
amma baba ki qasam dhaamp lo moo par chadar
dekha jayega na ab tum se ye khooni manzar
aray qatl hota hoo nigaahon ko hata lo amma
haye ya hussain haye ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
arz karte hi nawab ho gaya mehshar barpa
khaak udhane lagi maqtal mein janabe zahra
shadman jab ye sada shaah ne di
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
chal rahi hai meri...
author: Nawab Cholasvi
